enacted_as: Proposition 7 (November 5, 1974) — reorganization of California Declaration of Rights
notes: Section 13 carried over the search-and-seizure protection from the 1849 and 1879 California Constitutions. Proposition 7 reorganized Article I but did not substantively change the search-and-seizure guarantee. The text closely tracks the Fourth Amendment. Leginfo annotation confirms: 'Sec. 13 added Nov. 5, 1974, by Prop. 7; Res.Ch. 90, 1974.' The text of § 13 has never been amended since adoption.
